result.caveat: Estimate and review aid, not tax advice, filing approval or HMRC submission. Independent tax review and annual form mapping remain required.

trace.label: Recognised trading income
trace.formula: Sum signed approved income records

trace.label: Candidate trading expenses
trace.formula: Sum signed approved expense records; tax treatment still subject to review

trace.label: Candidate adjusted trading profit
trace.formula: Income − candidate expenses − net mileage substitution + reviewed adjustments

trace.label: Trading base after whole-pound rounding
trace.formula: Floor positive adjusted profit to whole pounds for calculation-stage trade/NI input

trace.label: Employment taxable pay
trace.formula: Sum each employment after rounding its taxable pay down to pounds

trace.label: Separate taxable termination components
trace.formula: Only reviewed taxable components, separate from employment totals

trace.label: Eligible gross RAS pension relief
trace.formula: Gross contribution ceiling to pounds, capped by greater of £3,600 and supported relevant UK earnings; not a trading expense

trace.label: Gross Gift Aid band extension
trace.formula: Round total eligible net donations up to pounds; gross ×5/4 and round up to pounds

trace.label: Adjusted net income
trace.formula: Taxable income before allowance minus eligible gross RAS/Gift Aid extension

trace.label: Personal Allowance
trace.formula: £12,570 less floor-to-pound of half ANI above £100,000, minimum zero

trace.label: Income Tax band 1
trace.formula: 0p × 2000/10000, floor pennies

trace.label: Income Tax band 2
trace.formula: 0p × 4000/10000, floor pennies

trace.label: Income Tax band 3
trace.formula: 0p × 4500/10000, floor pennies

trace.label: Income Tax estimate
trace.formula: Sum supported non-savings tax bands after allowance and band extension

trace.label: Class 4 before employment adjustment
trace.formula: 6%/2% portions rounded down separately to pennies

trace.label: Reg100 Class 4 cap
trace.formula: Stage 16 c16.20–31: each Class 1 band earning rounded up to pounds; standard equivalent rounded up to pennies

trace.label: Class 4 NI estimate
trace.formula: Lower of ordinary Class 4 and applicable Reg100 cap; exemption explicit

trace.label: Class 2 cash charge
trace.formula: No voluntary charge elected; entitlement/eligibility remains for review.

trace.label: Income Tax already withheld
trace.formula: Separate PAYE/other income withholding, never Class 1 NI

trace.label: Actual tax-year payment allocations
trace.formula: Only verified allocated amounts for this tax year; reserves excluded

trace.label: Assessed Income Tax and self-employed NI estimate
trace.formula: Income Tax + Class 4 + explicit Class 2, before withholding/payments

trace.label: Estimated balance after withholding and actual payments
trace.formula: Assessed liability − withholding − allocated actual payments; negative indicates potential repayment

trace.label: Relevant amount for following-year POA
trace.formula: Income Tax + Class 4 − qualifying withholding, minimum zero; exclude Class 2 and actual prior payments

trace.label: Each ordinary following-year payment on account
trace.formula: Half relevant amount, rounded down to pennies per instalment, unless below £1,000 or below 20% of assessed Income Tax + Class 4; no reduction claim assumed

trace.label: Estimated January balance plus first following-year POA
trace.formula: Balance after actual payments + first ordinary following-year POA

result.class2_treatment: No voluntary charge elected; entitlement/eligibility remains for review.
